purpose: Local realtime_pose_v1 source/task/result 3D viewer and task exporter.

entrypoints.api: python -m visual_editor.server --source_dir dataset/AMASS_realtime_pose_60hz --data_dir dataset/AMASS_realtime_pose_60hz_tasks --result_dir output --output_dir visual_editor/.runtime/exports

data_contract.source: realtime_pose_v1 source npz contains body_pose_parent_6d, root_pos_world, root_yaw, root_yaw_delta_sincos, tracker_pos_world, tracker_rot_world_6d, joints_world, joint_offsets_parent.
data_contract.task: materialized_realtime_pose_v1 task defaults to full-tracker sensor_valid and contains source arrays plus inpaint_mask, start_frame, valid_length, source_frames, seq_len; fixed sparse patterns are export-only for eval/debug.
